text: Garlic and onions are fundamental ingredients in many cuisines, adding depth and richness to various dishes. When used together, their flavors can be overpowering, so it's essential to cook them separately. By cooking garlic and onions individually, you can control the intensity of their flavors and prevent the onion from losing its crispness. Pairing them with other ingredients, such as herbs, spices, or proteins, will allow for harmonious results in your culinary creations.
summary: Garlic and onions enhance flavors, should be cooked separately for harmonious results.
